reviewer: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-14B nonthinking screens; assistant author formal adjudication
unresolved_findings_definition: Unresolved contradictions or unspecified mechanisms in the final formal material, not the number of model disagreements. All model disagreements and invalid judgments remain reported.
limitations: No new human validation. Screening checkpoints are separate from the target; Qwen3-14B shares its model family with Qwen3-32B.

Directional agreement is poor: model screening does not validate the gold labels. The source of the labels is the explicit finite rules, checked in two mathematical implementations and author adjudication.

Adjudication is by the assistant author, not a blinded independent human. Template-level logical checks resolve repeated claims of unspecified coupling, unknown outcomes, or wrong Boolean/negation logic.
The corpus has 80 parameterized instances, eight mechanism classes, and a shared outcome wrapper; it is not 80 independent mechanisms and does not establish real-world forecasting validity.
44 Llama review completions were invalid; these are retained as screening failures. None was regenerated or counted as an agreeing judgment.
Earlier candidate versions, both completed v3 screens, and the partial Qwen thinking screen remain archived. No target outputs informed material membership or revision.
repairs: v4 separates local procedural approval coin from final inspection and restricts independence to channel systems.
v5 explicitly states independence of primitive draws except specified dependencies and conditioning. Both reviewers screened all 720 final packets.
adjudication_method: Author comparison of the eight rule templates, global outcome formula, exact generated-instance checks and reviewer concern patterns. This is formal author adjudication, not an assertion that reviewers agreed or that every free-form rationale received independent human adjudication.
